HOW WEDSPARKS MAKES YOUR WEDDING PLANNING EASIER.

WedSparks brings wedding planning into one place, helping you discover trusted wedding suppliers, compare services and pricing, save your favourites, request quotes and manage the details of your day. From finding the right vendors to keeping your budget and plans organised, WedSparks gives you the tools to plan your wedding with less searching and more clarity.

Explore

Search trusted wedding suppliers by category, location, availability and budget to find a great fit.

Compare

Compare vendor profiles, pricing, services and reviews to see which options suit your wedding plans.

Connect

Save favourite suppliers, request quotes and keep every conversation organised in one central place.

Plan

Manage your wedding budget, tasks, bookings and details using practical planning tools in one place.
